name: All Aboard 2017
information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 100 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration. Your registration is not complete until you pay. You will be placed on a waiting list until you pay. With the WCA system, registration must be manually checked before approval, so please allow up to 48 hours to be moved from the waiting list. The event list consists of: 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, Feet, FMC, and Kilominx (unofficial).
